15506.description: Coarse active home load in Watts (snaps to ~100W steps)

15507.name: Operating Mode
15507.description: Native mode control: 1=Backup, 2=Self-Consumption, 3=TOU, 4=Manual. Write transactions are accepted at the protocol level but discarded internally without error on the firmware tested. Cause undetermined.

15508.name: Self-Consumption Reserve
15508.description: Self-consumption floor reserve percentage. Write transactions are accepted at the protocol level but discarded internally without error on the firmware tested. Cause undetermined.

15509.name: TOU Reserve
15509.description: Time-of-Use floor reserve percentage. Firmware defect: register always mirrors 15508 and cannot be configured independently via Modbus. If locked, write transactions are silently accepted at protocol level but discarded internally without error.

16000.name: High-Resolution Home Load
16000.description: Undocumented high-precision home load mirror in Watts (~1W resolution vs ~100W). Used preferentially by the library.
